## refreshVerifiedDomains

Refresh Verified Domains. `POST /email-providers/{provider_id}/refresh-domains`

Refresh the list of verified domains from the provider API.

Fetches current verified domains and updates provider config. Supports SendGrid and Mailgun. For Mailgun a domain-scoped SENDING key 401s on /v3/domains and the live list cannot be read — in that case the stored verified_domains degrades to the manually-configured domain.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailProviders()->refreshVerifiedDomains(providerId: 'provider_id');
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$providerId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `RefreshDomains`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Providers/refresh_verified_domains_api_v1_email_providers__provider_id__refresh_domains_post)
